page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.32xlarge is a compute-optimized instance within the Enhanced server family, operating on the KVM hypervisor. The system features 128 dedicated vCPUs driven by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 256.0 GB, establishing a 2.0 GB per core ratio aligned with compute-dense workload profiles.

The hardware configuration provides no bundled local NVMe storage, requiring reliance on remote block storage solutions. Network connectivity features a high baseline bandwidth capability of 160 Gbps without bundled complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance does not include discrete GPU accelerators.

The instance configuration emphasizes high processing core density paired with network throughput capability. Providing a 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio maximizes core allocation per resource tier, delivering cost efficiency for compute-bound processing tasks that do not require high per-core memory capacity or local disk storage. Appropriate workloads include parallel processing, high-throughput network appliances, software compilation pipelines, and web serving clusters.
